outline:
COURSE NUMBER – 287723
COURSE NAME- CLEAN ENERGY TECHNOLOGY

Clean Energy Technology is a basic course taught completely in English, mainly for the students who have not studied Environmental Sciences as a subject. Students can gain introductory knowledge related to sustainable energy sources and innovative techniques to reduce harmful negative environmental impacts like Global Warming and Climate Change by sustainable use of resources.

Week 1: Clean Energy Technology- Introduction and Basics
Week 2: Fossil Fuels
Week 3: Renewable Energy Sources
Week 4: Carbon Cycle
Week 5: Catastrophic Climate Change
Week 6: Carbon Sequestration
Week 7: Bio-geoengineering
Week 8: Earth's Energy Budget
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10: Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
Week 11: Sustainable Biofuels
Week 12: Hydrogen fuel cells
Week 13: Biological fuel cells
Week 14: Sustainable Agriculture
Week 15: Sustainable Conversion Technologies
Week 16: Carbon Farming
Week 17: Ecotourism
Week 18: Final Exam
schedule:
1. The class students will be separated into groups
2.	In each class the Teacher will first teach a PowerPoint presentation
3.	This will be followed by the presentations of the students in each group
4.	The students can use Powerpoint and YouTube videos to make their presentations interesting
assessment:
1.	The Teacher will conduct 2 exams during the course (Midterm and Final) for 50 marks
2.	The final score will be for 100% and it will be a sum of evaluations as 50% (from the final written exam) 25% (from the Midterm exam score) 15% (from the class presentations) 10% (from class attendance and attentiveness).
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】
